neighbours.label: a common noun like 'state', 'city' or 'country' directly after the indefinite 'a' (or 'no'), as in 'a state park' or 'a city dweller'; the same noun after 'the' stays quiet
fire: Last summer we camped for a week at a state forest near the lake.
The new law gives each family a state pension once they reach sixty-seven.
For years she worked as a city planner in the north of England.
He grew up on a farm, so living in a city apartment felt strange at first.
My cousin plays fiddle in a country music group on Friday nights.
The report found that a state agency had ignored dozens of complaints.
Her brother lost his job and applied for a state grant to retrain.
Every weekend the market draws a city crowd looking for cheap vegetables.
